caption: The video captures an aerial view of a hillside town blanketed by a thick sea of fog under a clear blue sky, with a tall red-and-white lattice communication tower rising above the cloud layer. The fog continuously swirls and flows across the slope, its billowing edges alternately obscuring and revealing the clustered buildings below. The tower, rooftops and horizon are fixed landscape elements, while the apparent motion comes from the drifting mist and a gradual change in framing. The framing gradually shifts, moving the small antenna at the far-left horizon out of view while keeping the tower centered. The cloud layer keeps rolling over the hillside, its surface undulating and its gaps widening and closing. Both the rolling fog and the framing change are already in progress and continue rather than resolving into a finished action. The scene holds its calm composition while the mist and viewpoint quietly evolve.
